evals.prompt: ok i'm ready to start building the FridgeChef MVP. idea id is 0001, all the workflow files are in workflow/ideas/, workflow/approach/, workflow/marketing/. the mvp/ folder is empty — nothing scaffolded yet. can you plan out the build? i want to know which parts can be built in parallel and which have to wait. demo target is the 'snap fridge → recipe in 5 seconds' moment for influencer videos.
evals.expected_output: plans/0001-plan-root.md plus several plans/todo/0001-NN-<slug>.md phase files. Root must list phases with blocked-by and parallel-safe columns. First phase should be design-system + scaffold (mvp/ is empty). Stack defaulted to React + RR + Zustand. A 'snap fridge' demo moment should be planned with a fake (static image, not real vision API).
assertions: root plan file exists at plans/0001-plan-root.md
root plan lists phases in a table or numbered structure
root plan declares per-phase dependencies (blocked by / depends on)
root plan calls out which phases are parallel-safe
root plan or some phase file mentions React, React Router, and Zustand as the stack
plan tree contains at least one phase covering design system or scaffold (mvp/ is empty)
plan tree contains at least one phase covering the 'snap fridge' capture moment
the snap/capture phase explicitly uses a fake or stub for vision recognition (no real model integration in MVP)
phase files live under plans/todo/ (per the skill's layout)
phase files use the {id}-{NN}-{slug}.md naming pattern

assertions: root plan file exists at plans/0002-plan-root.md
plan tree does NOT include a 'design system + scaffold' phase (mvp/ is already scaffolded)
plan tree contains a phase for the digest dashboard / theme-grouped bullets
plan tree contains a phase or task covering bullet editing
